grh_238f63f169388adc2e90.title: The Strange Case of the Murder in Wax
paragraphs: A serial killer is stabbing young women on Hampstead Heath, and Holmes notices that every victim except Rose Bishop had been with a man when attacked. The clue points toward someone close enough to Rose to know she would be alone. Holmes's investigation of a wax museum exposes proprietor LeBec, secretly Rose's father, as the murderer; in his warped pride as both wax artist and killer, LeBec even created a veiled wax figure of himself for the chamber of horrors. He tries to murder Holmes and Watson there with a knife, but Holmes sets the waxworks ablaze to force him into the open, and LeBec is captured.

[[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Basil Rathbone and Nigel Bruce. Other credited names include Edna Best as producer, Anthony Boucher as writer, Denis Green as writer, and Harry Bartell as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 30 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.bbd501bf461d302b|Petri Wines]] and [[org|org.bbd501bf461d302b|Petri Wines]].
This version is based on [[work|work.doyle.e1f5f4a54aac411d|The Adventure of the Second Stain]].

grh_2372ea68f7e9bc761eb4.title: A Slight Case of Murder
paragraphs: Former bootlegger Remy Marko goes legitimate after Prohibition and discovers that respectable business is harder than crime: his brewery is losing money, his beer is terrible, and foreclosure threatens. At home, old gang associates, a police-officer suitor for his daughter and a group of wanted criminals turn the household into comic chaos. grh_23eabd32627be363621f.title: Anniversary
paragraphs: A group of young people staying in an isolated house begin hearing voices, music and violent disturbances from a locked area they cannot explain. Their attempts to escape only deepen the mystery, and they eventually learn from a neighbor that the house belonged to singer Evelyn Dinell and her husband and manager John D'Costa, who died there in a murder-suicide.
